_note: Assignments flow-next.py writes to .hook-only/flow/prompts/<n>.md. {topic}, {text}, {commits} are filled in. Every assignment gets the common lines appended. Wording only; the transitions live in flow-next.py.
common: Test scope: the narrowest runs while iterating, the full suite only to confirm (agent-common). Don't commit, stash or switch branches; the orchestrator commits.
planner: Write `plans/tests/{topic}.md` for `plans/{topic}.md`. If a rule relies on an external fact (data source semantics, units, limits, API behaviour) that the plan doesn't cite a source for, stop and report `STATUS: BLOCKED` naming it. List open questions for the user in the report body as `Q1: ...`, and name them in the `QUESTIONS:` header line (`QUESTIONS: none` when there are none); decide internal contracts yourself and write them into the test plan.
planner-revise:
Revise `plans/tests/{topic}.md` (feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`): apply every finding of the spec reviewer below, quoted verbatim. Report open questions as in the first round (`QUESTIONS:` header line).

{text}
planner-decisions:
Record these decisions in `plans/tests/{topic}.md` (feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`): each one as a contract decision in the test plan, and remove the question it answers from the open questions. Report what changed, with `QUESTIONS: none` unless a decision raises a new one.

{text}
spec: Review `plans/tests/{topic}.md` against `plans/{topic}.md` and the design docs it references.
spec-again:
Fixed, please re-review `plans/tests/{topic}.md`. The planner's report of this revision:

{text}
qa: Turn the reviewed test plan `plans/tests/{topic}.md` (feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`) into automated tests. New tests must fail only because the implementation is missing (no parse or setup errors); existing tests must keep passing.
qa-regression: Small fix: write the smallest regression test for the bug in `plans/{topic}.md`. It must fail now, for that bug (not a parse or setup error).
qa-fix:
Add or fix tests for the findings below that are routed to QA (quoted verbatim; ignore the ones routed to the developer). Report which new tests fail now and why.

{text}
qa-refused: The orchestrator's commit of your tests was refused by the quality gate. The refusal is quoted in the dispatch message under `Refusal:`. Fix the tests so the commit passes.
dev: Implement `plans/{topic}.md` so that every test passes, without modifying tests. Test plan: `plans/tests/{topic}.md`. Tests committed in: {commits}.
dev-fix:
Fix the findings below that are routed to the developer (quoted verbatim; ignore the ones routed to QA), without modifying tests. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`. Tests committed in: {commits}.

{text}
dev-finish: Finish implementing `plans/{topic}.md` so that every test passes, without modifying tests. Tests committed in: {commits} (the latest commit adds the test your last report asked for).
dev-refused: The orchestrator's commit of your implementation was refused by the quality gate. The refusal is quoted in the dispatch message under `Refusal:`. Fix the implementation so the commit passes, without modifying tests. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`.
review-again: Fixed, please re-review. Commits since your last round: {commits}.
judge-questions:
Kind: questions. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`, test plan `plans/tests/{topic}.md`. Report with the questions, verbatim:

{text}
judge-blocked:
Kind: blocked. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`. Report of the {who}, verbatim:

{text}
judge-approve:
Kind: approve. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`, test plan `plans/tests/{topic}.md`. The code reviewer approved; its report, verbatim:

{text}
judge-route:
Kind: route. Feature plan `plans/{topic}.md`. The code reviewer requested changes but routed none of its must-fix findings to QA or the developer in a way the hook could read. Its report, verbatim:

{text}
resume: Continue from your CHECKPOINT: finish the remaining work of your assignment ({text}) within the new budget.
